--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Published: 6 months ago; **Cause:** CommonJS require() loaded a module whose graph contains top-level await or dynamic import() requirements that cannot be satisfied synchronously.**Solution:** Convert the caller to ESM, or use dynamic import('...') inside an async function.Since Node.js 22, fully synchronous ESM can be required from CommonJS.
